header.tagline: A set of tools for cellists – fingering, tuner, metronome, rhythms, bowing and more
about.title: About
about.p1: Cello App Kit is a set of tools for cellists. The Fingering tool analyses a sequence of notes and recommends the most suitable fingering with regard to position stability and minimising shifts.
about.p2: The algorithm prefers staying in one position, minimises shifts between positions, and favours lower positions. It supports enharmonic equivalents for correct handling of all scales. Output format (staff / text) is changed in Settings below the results.
features.title: Main features
features.algo.title: 🎯 Smart algorithm
features.algo.desc: Advanced algorithm that optimises fingering with regard to position stability, minimising shifts and favouring lower positions.
features.staff.title: 🎵 Staff and text output
features.staff.desc: Optional output: staff (bass clef, whole notes, positions above notes, fingers and note names as annotations, coloured strings) or text output (positions, fingers, notes). Toggle in Settings. Horizontal scroll on smaller screens.
features.fingerboard.title: 🎨 Visual fingerboard
features.fingerboard.desc: Realistic fingerboard visualisation with a black background (in both light and dark mode), showing the recommended fingering with coloured strings and hand-motion links. Proportional spacing between positions (smaller towards the bridge) matches real cello distances. Responsive with horizontal scroll.
features.tech.title: ⚙️ Technical features
features.tech.desc: Light/dark theme (device setting or manual toggle in menu), multilingual (menu – flags), H/B note naming in Settings. Test page for algorithm verification. In the footer you will find a link to the Accessibility statement and a description of keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Enter in the note input field runs the fingering suggestion).
tones.title: Tones, fingers and positions
tones.intro: Position label conversion table: diatonic (I, II↓, …) vs chromatic (I–XII, Roman numerals). The note is the tone on the A string with 1st finger in that position.
input.label: Enter notes with octave and accidentals, space-separated, e.g. C c c1 c1# gb or cis1 des

accessibility.intro: The Cello Fingering Assistant application aims to be accessible in line with web content accessibility requirements.
accessibility.compliance: Compliance level: Partially compliant with WCAG 2.1 (Level AA) – semantic HTML, contrast, form and button labels, keyboard support. Some interactive elements (e.g. fingerboard visualisation) may be fully usable mainly with mouse or touch.
accessibility.contact: Contact for accessibility feedback: Sensio.cz s.r.o., https://www.sensio.cz/
accessibility.shortcutEnter: Enter – in the note input field, runs the fingering suggestion ("Suggest fingering" button)
tuner.tagline: Tuner – open strings C, G, d, a
tuner.title: Tuner
tuner.intro: Allow microphone access. Choose reference pitch and equal temperament or pure fifths.
metronome.title: Metronome
metronome.intro: Set tempo (BPM) and beats per bar. Start the metronome before you begin playing.
countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.intro: Set the practice length in minutes and start the countdown. It will ring at the end.
guide.intro: Cello App Kit is a set of tools for cellists: countdown, tuner, fingering, rhythms, bowing, metronome and sheet list. Follow the steps below – at each step you can go directly to the tool or continue with Next.
guide.step1Desc: Set a countdown so you know when to stop.
guide.step2Desc: Use the tuner to tune open strings C, G, d, a.
guide.step3Desc: Pick a piece or scale from the sheet list.
guide.step4Desc: Enter notes and get a suggested fingering, or edit it.
guide.step5Desc: Apply a rhythm pattern (quarter, eighth notes) to the sequence.
guide.step6Desc: Apply a bowing pattern (legato, separate) to the sequence.
guide.step7Desc: Set tempo and start the metronome before playing.
guide.step8Title: Start countdown and play until it rings
guide.step8Desc: Start the countdown and practice until it rings.
rhythms.title: Rhythms
rhythms.intro: Loads the sequence from the Fingering tool and applies the selected rhythm pattern (quarter and eighth notes).
rhythms.noData: Create a fingering on the Fingering page first.
bowing.title: Bowing
bowing.intro: Loads the sequence from the Fingering tool and applies the selected bowing pattern (legato = slur, separate = no change).
bowing.noData: Create a fingering on the Fingering page first.
sheetList.title: Sheet list
sheetList.intro: Add a link to sheet music with title, author and difficulty (1–10). Sort and filter the list.
sheetList.author: Author:
home.intro: Cello App Kit is a set of tools for cellists: countdown, tuner, fingering, rhythms, bowing, metronome and sheet list. Below is an overview of the tools in the recommended order.
home.tool1Desc: Countdown timer – set your practice length in minutes and start the countdown. It rings at the end. Ideal first step before practising.
home.tool2Desc: Cello tuner – tune open strings C, G, d, a. Microphone, choice of reference A (440–443 Hz), equal temperament or pure fifths.
home.tool3Desc: Sheet list – add links to pieces or scales with title, author and difficulty (1–10). Sort and filter by difficulty.
home.tool4Desc: Fingering – enter a sequence of notes and get a suggested fingering with fingerboard visualisation, staff notation and playback. Supports German notation (cis, es).
home.tool5Desc: Rhythms – apply rhythm patterns (quarter, eighth notes) to a sequence from Fingering. Renders staff with beams.
home.tool6Desc: Bowing – apply bowing patterns (legato, separate) to a sequence from Fingering. Renders slurs between notes.
home.tool7Desc: Metronome – set tempo (BPM) and time signature (2, 3, 4, 6). Two beat types (accent / lighter). Start before you begin playing.
